title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E2 — Mandrill/LaBelle
Mrs. Georgia Jackson, mother of slain Soledad Brother George Jackson, is interviewed by producer- Ellis Haizlip.  Other show features include the exciting Latin-jazz sounds of  seven man combo.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E13 — What Price Friendship?
Webster tries to buy friendship to fit in with the two coolest kids in his school, Joey and David. George finds out he's supposed to speak at a ceremony for Gloria Steinem.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E1 — San Francisco: Part 1
Webster, Katherine and George help a musician (played by Lee Weaver) make his way to San Francisco to play with his old band at their 40th reunion show.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E2 — Katherine, the Greek
When George is a flop at predicting football games, he enlists the aid of Katherine, who proves to have an uncanny knack for picking winners.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E3 — Hello, Nicky
Webster helps his cousin Nicky, who's afraid to tell his family that he doesn't want to move to Nigeria with them.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E4 — Breaking Away
An enthusiastic George takes the family on a fishing trip, but all Webster can think about is the fun he could be having with his buddies.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E7 — Halloween
While the twins go in search of a Halloween rave, Lisa and Ray attend a fancy party thrown by a prospective client.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E8 — Weird Science
Tia and Tamera think they're in for a "free ride" when Ray starts dating their science teacher.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E9 — Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part I)
When Ray and Lisa take the girls to Hawaii for Thanksgiving, they're forced to share their condo with their "exes," who have begun dating each other.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E10 — Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part II)
While Ray and Lisa frantically search for the twins, who are missing in Hawaii, Roger opens the Campbell/Landry home to hobos for Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E11 — Private School
The prospect of Tia's attending a prestigious prep school puts social pressure on Tia and financial pressure on Lisa.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E4 — Mis-Directed Study
Moesha is flying high after she gets a job tutoring one of the basketball team’s star players until she finds out what kind of game he really wants to play.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E1 — Good Vibrations?
A frustrated Moesha longs for a promotion from 'gopher' to writer at Vibe magazine but believes that her boss, Joe Scott, would rather she pay her dues with something other than her writing talent.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E2 — Fired Up
Eager to get on the fast track at Vibe Magazine, Moesha pretends to be a reporter to land a Maya Angelou interview.  But her ambition, coupled with Maya’s advice, leads Moesha down an entirely different path than she’d planned.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E3 — The Party’s Over (Here)
Unable to resist the temptations of college life, Moesha and Niecy become regulars on the party circuit, until their attendance at a late-night frat party takes its toll in more ways than one.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E5 — Not My Pumpkin
Things get tense at the Mitchell house when Frank discovers Moesha has been taking birth control pills – and he’s the last to know.

S3 E4 — The Sing-Off
In charge of the big choir competition, Mary must make room in her have for the visiting choir's deacon, who is notoriously arrogant, thoughtless and pushy.

S3 E5 — And Baby Makes Three
Alarmed by Brenda and her friends' casual attitude about teen pregnancy, Mary uses some unusual methods to teach them a lesson about parenting that they'll never forget.

S3 E6 — Men's Club
Mary is delighted to learn that Lester will be named 'Man of the Year' by the local Men's Club...and distraught upon discovering she's not allowed to attend the special ceremony.

S3 E7 — Low Noon
To protest the opening of a sleazy club in her neighborhood, Mary dreams of running the varmints out of town.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E19 — The Slender Arm Of The Law
Eddie tries to help out the retired race car driver who helped get his first job.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E20 — A Few So-So Men
Malcolm unwittingly hires Eddie's longtime enemy to install a new bar at McGee's.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E21 — A Delicate Procedure
After agreeing to date Tim's sister, Malcolm must then find a way to break up.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E22 — Car Trouble
Eddie finds a gangster's hidden cash hidden inside Malcolm's new car.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E23 — Kansas City Split
When Malcolm falls for a spiritual guru and Eddie gets a new job offer, they agree to sell the business and move on.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E8 — Great Sanford Siege
Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E9 — Coffins For Sale
Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E10 — The Barracuda
Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E11 — Tv Or Not Tv
Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E5 — George's Dream
Obsessed with landing a crucial new cleaning account, an overwrought and exhausted George lapses into sleep and wakes up to a terrifying look at his future.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E6 — George's New Stockbroker
George is fascinated by a highly successful -- if unconventional -- stockbroker, until he finds out about his unusual medical past.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E7 — Me And Billy Dee
Billy Dee Williams makes a guest appearance in the Jefferson living room, but can't convince his 'number one fan' Florence that he is who he is.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.
